description: This Java source file defines the InlineRequestHelper class, which provides utility methods for handling inline suggestions and autofill datasets in an Android autofill service, including creating inline presentations, slices, and attribution pending intents.

classes.name: InlineRequestHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to create inline suggestions, datasets, and attribution intents for Android autofill inline suggestions.

methods.name: getInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the InlineSuggestionsRequest from a FillRequest if available and valid.

methods.name: getMaxSuggestionCount
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of suggestions to display based on the inline request and a provided max limit.

methods.name: maybeCreateInlineAuthenticationResponse
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation for authentication response if an inline suggestions request is present.

methods.name: createInlineDataset
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation dataset with a given value and index based on the inline suggestions request.

methods.name: createInlineActionDataset
methods.description: Creates a Dataset with inline presentation and an authentication PendingIntent for an action.

methods.name: createInlineAction
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation representing an inline action with an icon.

methods.name: createSlice
methods.description: Builds a Slice object with optional title, subtitle, icons, and attribution.

methods.name: createAttribution
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for attribution dialog with a message.
